representation_paths.memory_component: drift-resilient memory bank of visual-object and textual-task anchors

evidence.paraphrase: Memory-bank anchor entries; hypernetwork-generated LoRA adapter weights. anchor retrieval conditions a hypernetwork that generates per-task LoRA adapters.

Retrieved visual-object and textual-task anchors are updated online through a fixed momentum-style procedure; the memory policy itself is not self-evolving. For HyLoVQA, this specifically supports a fixed operational optimization objective of drift-resilient memory bank of visual-object and textual-task anchors.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are deliberately linked or jointly consumed by downstream reasoning, generation, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (drift-resilient memory bank of visual-object and textual-task anchors) changes through a fixed operational optimization objective; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
